items.title: Step-panel rows: the label truncates before the command column instead of running under it (SimPanel; PerfPanel's twin renderer too); move the local v1.76.0 tag
items.spec:
Owner report 2026-10-23 (inputs/addendum-02-simpanel-overlap.png, BankLedger's sim panel). A long step label ("Deposit 1 x Flask of the Shattered Sun to Character Bank (1 recorded)") runs under the right-hand command column (/bl sim step) and the two texts overlap. Cause: LibKa0s/SimPanel.lua's row builder (~:296-306) anchors b.text only LEFT (LABEL_X) and b.cmd only RIGHT (-CMD_PAD), so nothing bounds the label.
FIX (tests first):
- In SimPanel.lua's row renderer, anchor the label's RIGHT to the command's LEFT with a gap (e.g. -8), give it SetJustifyH("LEFT") and SetWordWrap(false), so a long label truncates with an ellipsis. The command keeps its natural width (right column). A row with no command lets the label run to the row's right inset. The full label stays reachable: the row's tooltip already opens with row.label (showTip); keep it, and assert it.
- Re-measure on resize: the panel is resizable (MakeResizable), so the anchors (not a fixed width) must do it.
- PerfPanel.lua has the deliberately duplicated renderer (its header names the duplication). Apply the same fix there, at the same geometry.
- Headless tests in tests/test_sim_panel.lua and the PerfPanel suite: the label has two horizontal anchors (LEFT at LABEL_X, RIGHT at cmd LEFT - gap), word wrap is off, the tooltip's first line is the full label, and a row with an empty command anchors to the row's right inset.
VERSIONS: v1.76.0 is unreleased (local tag only). Follow docs/releasing.md on whether SimPanel/PerfPanel take a further minor within the same release or keep the one already bumped this release (SimPanel 5); in either case the payload changes, so add a CHANGELOG bullet to the v1.76.0 section and update docs/api if it describes the row layout. Regenerate docs/test-cases.md.
TAG: after the gates are green, move the LOCAL tag to this item's last commit: `git tag -f -a v1.76.0 -m 'LibKa0s v1.76.0'`, and append the old and new sha to ../Ka0sAddonsCommonTasks/docs/2026-10-23-SIM_PREVIEW_MODE_STRIPS/99_EXECUTION_RECORD.md (no commit there). Never push the tag.
items.verify: test_sim_panel + perf panel suites; luacheck 0/0; lua tests/run.lua; git rev-parse v1.76.0^{commit} == HEAD
smoke: SM-LK-1: /bl sim start bank: every step label fits its row; a long one ends in an ellipsis before the /bl sim step column, never under it; hovering the row shows the full label; resize the panel wider and the label shows more

items.title: Simulation stalls a few seconds on step 4 (Deposit 1 x Flask...) before it plays on: find why and remove the stall
items.spec:
Owner report 2026-10-23: /bl sim start bank works, but the run sits on step 4 ("Deposit 1 x Flask of the Shattered Sun to Character Bank (1 recorded)") for a few seconds before it moves on. The other steps pace at about 1 s.
METHOD (superpowers:systematic-debugging; no fix before a cause):
1. Reproduce headlessly. Run the bank scenario through RunVerb('start bank') with the kit clock, and log for each step the time between its play and the next tick. Show where step 4's extra wait comes from. Candidates to check, not conclusions: the host gate (closed while the ledger settles: a debounce, a bucket, a deferred write, a GetItemInfo / Item:ContinueOnItemLoad wait for an uncached item); this step's own play doing async work; the step delay function returning more for this step kind; SimTimeline's GATE_POLL re-polls.
2. If it comes from an item-info load (the flask is not cached in a fresh client), decide the right behavior. Either the scenario's items are primed at prepare (before ready()), so no step waits mid-run, or the gate's wait is legitimate and the step panel should say why (its busy row's tip). Prefer priming at prepare, the BL-08 / DW pool precedent.
3. If it comes from BankLedger's settle or debounce timing, make the gate open as soon as the write it waits for has landed.
Tests first: a case asserting that every step of the bank scenario plays within stepDelay + one GATE_POLL of the previous one, with item info answered late for the flask, red before the fix.
Ripple: docs/smoke-tests.md (a check mirroring SM-BL-14, pending), CHANGELOG/Unreleased per the repo's convention, the test inventory.
items.verify: the pacing case; luacheck 0/0; lua tests/run.lua
smoke: SM-BL-14: in a freshly started client, /bl sim start bank: every step, including step 4 (the flask deposit), follows the previous one about 1 s later with no multi-second stall
